{{Quote|Do not worry, Wing. Things have changed. Everything has changed. Maybe even Magistrate Elsbeth.|Nadura|<ref name="The Path of Hate" />}}
'''Nadura''' was an [[Unidentified species (Corvus)|alien]] [[ambassador]] in the [[New Republic]] following the defeat of the [[Galactic Empire]]. Formerly a resident of the [[planet]] [[Corvus]], Nadura left after [[Magistrate]] [[Morgan Elsbeth]] forced the people of [[Calodan]] to labor in [[Factory|factories]]. After becoming an ambassador of the New Republic, Nadura returned to Corvus in the hope of seeing the planet join the [[New Republic Senate|Senate]]. Although [[Wing]] tried to dissuade her, Nadura chose to speak with Elsbeth, demanding that she stand down and turn herself in to stand trial for her crimes, promising that if she did so, Nadura would ensure she received a fair trial. Elsbeth refused to step down, however, and ordered her [[Scout guard|guards]] to [[Death|kill]] the ambassador. Nadura attempted to escape, but Elsbeth's guards destroyed her [[starship]], with the ambassador being caught in the explosion. However, Nadura had managed to send a [[distress signal]] to [[Bo-Katan Kryze]], and the ambassador promised Wing that help would come before she died.<ref name="The Path of Hate" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Nadura appeared in the ''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Empire]]'' episode "[[The Path of Hate]]," voiced by [[Shelby Young]]. The episode premiered alongside the rest of the series<ref name="The Path of Hate" /> on [[May 4]], [[2024]].<ref name="Release">{{SW|url=news/tales-of-the-empire-trailer|text=''Star Wars: Tales of the Empire'' Trailer Revealed}}</ref>
